definitions.short: Ashshur , the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
definitions.full: H804. Ashshuwr אַשּׁוּר proper name, of a people & territory Asshur, Assyria (Assyrian Aššur , land & city Dl Pa 252 COT on Gen 2:14 ; Persian Athura , Syriac ; on the connection with name of god Ašur , & with √ אשׁר = ישׁר good, gracious , compare COT l.c .; see also Jen ZA, 1886, 1 f. Schr ib. 209 f. Nö ib. 268 f. ) 1 Asshur as person, 2nd son of Shem Gen 10:22 (P, in table of nations) 1Chr 1:17 . 2 people of Asshur (often as invading army & even world-power) Num 24:22 , 24 (poem of Balaam) Hosea 12:2 ; 14:4 ; Isa 10:5 ; 14:25 ; 19:23 (twice in verse); 19:24-25 , 23:13 ; 30:31 ; 31:8 ; 52:4 ; Lam 5:6 ; Ezek 23:5 ; 27:23 ; 32:22 (here feminine) Zech 10:11 ; Psa 83:9 perhaps read גְּשׁוּר , compare 2Sam 2:9 below אֲשׁוּרִי ; or (if Psalm 83 be late) regard אַשּׁוּר (like עֲמָלֵק ib. ) as used because of ancient significance; sometimes personified as one Isa 10:5 ; Ezek 31:3 (but strike out Co q. v.), compare also Micah 5:4 ; 5:5 ; Zeph 2:13 ; א ׳מַחֲנֵה 2Kin 19:32 = Isa 37:36 ; א ׳בְּנֵי Ezek 16:28 ; 23:7 , 9 , 12 , 23 . 3 land of Assyria Gen 2:14 ; 10:11 ; Hosea 5:13 ; 7:11 ; 8:9 ; 9:3 ; 10:6 ; Isa 11:11 , 16 ; 19:23 ; Jer 2:18 , 36 ; Micah 7:12 ; Zech 10:10 ; אַשּׁ֫וּרָה Gen 25:18 ; Isa 19:23 ; 2Kin 15:29 ; 17:6 , 23 ; 18:11 ; אַשּׁוּר אֶרֶץ Isa 7:18 ; 27:13 ; Hosea 11:11 ; Micah 5:5 . 4 especially אַשּׁוּר מֶלֶךְ Isa 8:4 ; 10:12 ; 20:1 , 4 , 6 (probably gloss 7:17 , 20 ; 8:7 ) 2Kin 15:19 41t. 2Kings; 14t. Isaiah 36-38; 1Chr 5:6 ( אַשֻּׁר ) + 13 t. Chronicles; also Jer 50:17-18 , Nahum 3:18 ; Ezra 4:2 ; (only 6:22 of Persian or any king not strictly Assyrian); note also א ׳הַמֶּלֶךְ Isa 36:8 , 16 ( ׳א perhaps gloss, compare Di who holds same view as to 2Kin 18:23 , 31 ); א ׳מַלְכֵי 19:11 , 17 = Isa 37:11 , 18 ; 2Chr 28:16 ; 30:6 ; Neh 9:32 .
